headline: GW7 captain options ranked by expected points: Haaland 7.2, then a big gap
body: Ran the numbers for GW7. Haaland is the clear #1 (7.2 xPts, 75% owned), then Groß at 5.5 and Saka at 4.7. Everyone after that is bunched around 4.2-4.4. Saka is owned by under 17% and the next big differential, Vuskovic, is under 5%. Is anyone going against the grain this week?   submitted by   /u/FballLegend [link]   [comments]
